item.title: Cloudflare Tests Cache Transcoding to Reduce Storage Requirements
item.description: Cloudflare recently described a prototype called Cache Transcoding that compresses eligible cache content, mainly uncompressed text such as HTML, JSON, CSS, and JavaScript, using Zstandard before storing it on disk. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Sentry Says It Crashed. Datadog Says It's Slow. Expo Tells You Why
item.description: Mobile performance you can trust directly in your Expo dashboard (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Free 14-day trial, try the demo app today!
item.description: STRICH is a JavaScript SDK for real-time, 1D/2D barcode scanning in web apps. STRICH is fast, reliable and has competitive, transparent pricing. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Roux: A Boilerplate of Pre-Defined Native CSS Styling
item.description: A boilerplate of pre-defined native CSS styling. Contribute to thoughtbot/roux development by creating an account on GitHub. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: The Fixi Project: A Collection of Small Web Libraries by the Creators of htmx
WCAG Radar: Run Accessibility Checks on Pages You Have Open
item.description: Drag WCAG Radar to your bookmarks bar and test any page in your own browser. 29 of the 50 checks are free. Works behind a login and on localhost. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Confectionery: A Browser for Taking Cleaner Screenshots
item.description: A minimalist macOS browser that keeps tabs, toolbars, extensions, and other browser clutter out of your website screenshots. (1 source: frontendfocus)
